mechanism: Primaquine may induce hepatic metabolism of levonorgestrel via CYP3A4, potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy, while levonorgestrel may affect primaquine metabolism and hemolytic risk in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Consider alternative contraceptive methods or ensure reliable backup contraception; monitor for signs of hemolysis if G6PD status unknown; counsel on reduced contraceptive reliability.
